attrs.value: It's as if this land was built for war.
I know what you mean. Everything's designed to make it hard to get in or out.
There are natural chokepoints everywhere. Assaulting that War Machine could be a strategic nightmare.
It's too bad they don't know that we also have a few tricks up our sleeves.
Would you like to command the Lancers, Tucker?
But those are your secret weapon.
There is no greater thrill than to observe a great weapon wielded with skill. I am curious to see how a man known for his sharp and efficient strikes would make use of a machine like the Lancer.
Remember, Tucker. The penetrating shot of the Lancer's attack will damage two units if they are foolish enough to line themselves up in front of it.
I'll try to make the Dragoons proud.
A fine victory, Tucker. Well done.
Things seem to be going according to battle plans. It makes me nervous. It can't be this easy.
Durand is a coward at heart. He has depended on lies and subterfuge to wreak his havoc. He never would have defeated the Dragoon nation without an unprovoked and surprise invasion.
Then let's keep this convoy moving! We've got a job to do.
Good day, gentlemen. Those Lancers are quite useful.
At your hands? No. I don't think so. No Argent? That's too bad. I guess he wasn't good enough without his pal Tucker to save him all the time. I bet that will weigh on the conscience.
Hayne is surely no match for Federation forces. He was brash and thoughtless, no match for Captain Argent's wit.
And yet, he's not here. Very interesting. I should leave you time to mourn, Tucker. See you soon.
Do not worry, Tucker. He will answer for his crimes, we will see to it. And I am sure your comrade is safe.
I am fairly certain that my young ones back at home, fresh off of the playground, would drive a Lancer better than you have just done, Tucker.
